conversion_notes: The main paper is normalized: hyphenation across line breaks, running headers and page numbers are removed, and the equations are transcribed into standard LaTeX while keeping the paper's own symbols.
The tridiagonal matrices printed in the PDF are given componentwise, by their diagonal and off-diagonal entries, which is equivalent and easier to implement from.

The proof appendix (source pages 25-36) is not normalized. appendix-proofs.md keeps the fixed-width PDF text and pairs every page with its rendered image, so a dense intermediate step can be checked against the source instead of being silently rewritten.
equations.md is a flat index of the model and quote formulas, meant for retrieval rather than reading.

The backtest section is kept conservative: the paper illustrates the model on one day of France Telecom data and does not disclose the production algorithm, and the conversion does not fill in the gap.
